title: Zoning, Playgrounds & Tax Relief in Austin
summary:
*   A public hearing was scheduled to review a request to rezone a lot from residential to commercial.
*   $9,000 was approved for the development of Palm Playground, investing in public recreation.
*   New infrastructure was greenlit, permitting Texas Public Service Company to lay gas mains across several city streets.
*   A new tax policy exempted temporarily stored goods, such as pecans and cotton destined for interstate shipment, from local property taxes.
